lines.en: I skim just above the grass tips.

lines.zh: 翅膀嗡嗡，我绕着树转圈。
lines.en: My wings buzz as I circle the tree.
I hop along; I can't walk fast.

lines.zh: 我沿着花丛往林子深处去。
lines.en: I follow the flowers deeper into the woods.

lines.zh: 草上的露水沾湿了我的脚。
lines.en: The dew on the grass has soaked my feet.

lines.zh: 我飞一段，落下来歇口气。
lines.en: I fly a stretch, then land to catch my breath.
There's a small path under the bushes.

lines.zh: 我追着一只蝴蝶跑远了。
lines.en: I chased a butterfly too far.
I go around the stone so I don't hit a bug.

lines.zh: 风一来，我就被吹得打偏。
lines.en: One gust and I'm blown off course.
I'm heading for that bright patch.
My wings tire, so I glide for a while.
I sit on a petal swinging my legs.

lines.zh: 我在数自己能发出几颗弹。
lines.en: I count how many shots I can fire.
The sun makes my eyes swim.
I fold my wings to sun them.
A bee is contesting my flower.
I hum a tune with no proper shape.

lines.zh: 我的光在草里一闪一闪。
lines.en: My glow blinks in and out of the grass.
I count the holes in a leaf.
I wait for dark so I can go see the lights.
Someone far off is firing danmaku.

lines.zh: 我的力气只够飞一小会。
lines.en: My strength lasts only a short flight.
I shake pollen onto my dress.
A grass blade sways and I'm awake.
I hide behind a leaf to slack off.

lines.zh: 我把手心的光搓成一颗弹。
lines.en: I roll the light in my palm into a bullet.

lines.zh: 水面映出我，我朝自己挥手。
lines.en: I see myself in the water and wave back.

lines.zh: 你好大，像一棵走路的树。
lines.en: You're huge, like a walking tree.
Can you shoot bullets too?

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩坏了我三朵花。
lines.en: Your boots crushed three of my flowers.
I fly up to the height of your eyes.
That thing in your hand is glowing.

lines.zh: 你低头，我看不清你的脸。
lines.en: Look down; I can't see your face.
Have you come to hit me?
I flew two circles around you.
You carry a reek of iron about you.
Hold still; I'll rest on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的影子能把我整个罩住。
lines.en: Your shadow could swallow my whole body.

lines.zh: 你要不要看我发一颗弹。
lines.en: Want to see me fire one shot?

lines.zh: 我说话很轻，你听得见吗。
lines.en: I speak softly; can you hear me?

lines.zh: 你脸上怎么一点笑都没有。
lines.en: Why is there no smile on your face?
It hurts; my wing is bent.
Your aim is far too good.
I've dropped into the grass.

lines.zh: 翅膀被扯了一下，我掉了几片粉。
lines.en: My wings are yanked and a few scales drift off.
Not the head; I'll get dizzy.
I can't fly; wait a moment.
This little wound will heal soon.
There's a tear in my dress.
I hide behind a leaf.
Just you wait; I'll remember you briefly.
Something sweet? Give me a little.
The nectar in that flower is mine.
I can only manage a tiny bite.
The candy wrapper in your hand glints.
I smell honey, truly I do.
For me? I'll trade you a wingbeat.
Not that high; my arms are far too short.
A crumb is enough; my stomach is small.
Crouch down; flying has tired me.

lines.zh: 我吃完就给你颗火力点。
lines.en: After eating I'll give you a power point.
Hey, you knocked me flying.
I'm not even the size of your palm.
My wing got pressed.
Don't you watch your feet?

lines.zh: 你一下把我撞得打了转。
lines.en: One bump sent me spinning around.
Don't swat me; I'll fall apart.

lines.zh: 我只是想停在你帽子上。
lines.en: I only wanted to land on your hat.
The shadow under your foot is mine.
Excuse me; I need to fly past.
A bump is fine; I'm light.
Fairies hold no grudges, and remember no one.
Will you dance with me a while?

lines.zh: 我们妖精活得短，玩得久。
lines.en: We fairies live briefly and play long.
Just hold hands and spin.
Don't promise; I'll forget by tomorrow.
I prefer a crowd making noise together.
You're clumsy, but you're fun.

lines.zh: 花开的季节才适合这样。
lines.en: This suits the season when flowers open.
When I tire of flying I'll lean on you.
Let's watch one sunrise together.

lines.zh: 这颗亮晶晶的，我拿走了。
lines.en: This shiny one, I'm taking it.
I can't lift it, so I drag it.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的弹壳我收着。
lines.en: I keep the casings that fall on the ground.
This candy is bigger than I am.
I picked up a feather to wear as a cape.
Someone's lost button — I'll keep it.
I spotted this first, so it's mine.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进空树干深处。
lines.en: I wedge it deep inside a hollow trunk.
Too heavy; I dropped it.
Found things must be stowed out of sight.

lines.zh: 那边有个会动的大东西。
lines.en: There's a big moving thing over there.
Let's see whether it fears my shots.
It crushed the flowers; I saw it.
This target is big enough to hit.
My shots are already lined up.
It seems to be looking at me.
Running won't help; I fly faster.
Something's happening; I'll join in.
It's wearing iron; it will ring.
I'll take it on alone.
It's too tall; I'll go around behind.
Whoever strikes first wins.
I hover above the back of its neck.
I've worked out the trajectory.
Just like that; don't turn around.
I fire when I count to three.
Its ears are twitching.
I circle left, then circle right.
This close, it can't escape.
My glow will dazzle its eyes.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，连气都不喘。
lines.en: I'm keeping perfectly still and silent.
The moment it moves, I fire.
Wings, don't tremble — steady.
I wait for it to slip up first.

lines.zh: 打中就笑，打不中就再飞。
lines.en: Hit and I laugh; miss and I fly again.
I bump into its nose.
A shot lands square on its forehead.
I grab a fistful of its hair.
One bite, and then I run.
I've got it flailing about.
I add two more shots.
My shots are small, but there are many.
A hit — I've won half a move.
Its arm swings over; I dodge.
I swing back around and bump it again.
I pop out of a grass seed.

lines.zh: 花瓣一开，我就有了身子。
lines.en: A petal opens and I have a body.
I've been born again — how nice.
This time I'll fly a little farther.

lines.zh: 露水还没干，我正好出来。
lines.en: The dew's still wet; perfect timing.
I shake my new wings and test them.

lines.zh: 谁把我放在这片林子的。
lines.en: Who put me in this grove?
Good sunlight; I'll spin twice first.

lines.zh: 我记得上次是怎么没的。
lines.en: I remember how I went last time.
I still smell of flowers.
The forest is lively again.
I checked, and my friends are still here.

lines.zh: 妖精死了又回来，不稀奇。
lines.en: Fairies die and return; nothing strange.
Today I'll play until dark.
The flame singed the edge of my wing.

lines.zh: 我从半空掉下来，摔懵了。
lines.en: I dropped from midair and landed dazed.

lines.zh: 我掉进水里，翅膀贴住了。
lines.en: I fell in the water; my wings are stuck.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹到树上，翅膀卡住了。
lines.en: The blast throws me into a tree; my wings catch.
An arrow grazed my waist.

lines.zh: 这法术压得我抬不起头。
lines.en: This magic presses me down.
I'm too hungry to fly.
The thunder leaves my ears buzzing.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，我掉下去了。
lines.en: Below is nothing; I'm falling.
